CLAY_CKPT.description: Frozen Clay v1.5 large backbone for embedding extraction.
CLAY_CKPT.availability: External input; supply it at the configured filesystem path and verify hashes against its protocol or manifest. Binary data is excluded from Git.

CLAY_META.description: Six-band normalization metadata used by the frozen Clay encoder.

FULL_NUISANCE_MATCHING_POOL.description: Full-chip spectral statistics and nuisance measurements for eligible candidates.
FULL_NUISANCE_MATCHING_POOL.availability: Included in repository; regenerate from canonical chips if needed.

FULL_NUISANCE_BALANCE_OUTPUT.description: Current saved partitions, metrics and predictions; checkpoints and embeddings are external binary artifacts.
FULL_NUISANCE_BALANCE_OUTPUT.availability: Manifests and metrics included; classifier checkpoints and embeddings.npz are external generated artifacts.

S2_CAMPAIGNS_DIR.description: Prepared Sentinel-2 campaign crops and scene metadata for June, July and September observations.
S2_CAMPAIGNS_DIR.availability: External input; supply it at the configured filesystem path and verify hashes against its protocol or manifest. Binary data is excluded from Git.

PNEO_DIR.description: Licensed Pléiades Neo source imagery for the Sesimbra campaigns; not redistributed.
PNEO_DIR.availability: External input; supply it at the configured filesystem path and verify hashes against its protocol or manifest. Binary data is excluded from Git.

GBIF_MASTER.description: Saved European kelp occurrence export used for source selection.
GBIF_MASTER.availability: External source export; download-specific DOI is not recorded.

JNCC_DATABASE.description: Marine Recorder v52 Access database from public snapshot v20220124.

OBIS_DIR.description: OBIS source exports used by the collection workflow.

CHECKPOINTS_DIR.description: Root containing all 24 trained evaluation models: eighteen PyTorch heads and six logistic-regression pipelines. Each catalog relative_path is resolved beneath this directory; verify its SHA-256.
CHECKPOINTS_DIR.availability: External input; supply it at the configured filesystem path and verify hashes against its protocol or manifest. Binary data is excluded from Git.

FINAL_MODELS_DIR.description: Final train/validation manifests, metrics, model catalog and the two published model.pt checkpoints are included. New training writes to a fresh configured directory.

FINAL_CHECKPOINTS_DIR.description: Contains small_mlp_pool5/model.pt and mlp_pool1/model.pt; resolve catalog relative paths here.
FINAL_CHECKPOINTS_DIR.availability: Included in repository: small_mlp_pool5/model.pt and mlp_pool1/model.pt. Verify SHA-256 against the final-model catalog.

FULL_NUISANCE_EMBEDDINGS.description: Frozen full-chip Clay cache using 128-to-224 resizing and derived encoder GSD 128*10/224 m; companion protocol.json is required. Contains chip_ids, sha256, CLS vectors and central 7x7 patch-token windows. Used by comparison replay and to construct matching pool1 or pool5 embeddings for the final heads.
FULL_NUISANCE_EMBEDDINGS.availability: External input; supply it at the configured filesystem path and verify hashes against its protocol or manifest. Binary data is excluded from Git.

SESIMBRA_EVALUATION_DIR.description: Campaign-matched chip manifest, predictions and rasters. External generated observation_chips.h5 contains 52 native seven-layer chips; embeddings.npz contains CLS and central patch tokens; campaign raster_tokens.npz stores patch-score grids for verification.

PNEO_SEPTEMBER_FEATURES.description: Current six-band and Lyzenga quadrat feature table for September.

PNEO_CLAY_METADATA.description: Quadrat IDs, coordinates and labels aligned with the PNEO embedding cache.

PNEO_CLAY_EMBEDDINGS.description: External frozen Clay embeddings from licensed PNEO, containing CLS and centre patch arrays.

PNEO_SEPTEMBER_RESULTS.description: September exploratory held-out-transect results, features and paired feature analysis.

PNEO_SEPTEMBER_INPUTS.description: Fresh output directory for extracting September features and embeddings from licensed imagery.

CANONICAL_CHIPS_H5.description: Canonical uint16 Sentinel-2 chips.h5: eight layers, 128x128 pixels. Required for embedding extraction and independent feature verification. Selected rows record h5_index and array SHA-256.
CANONICAL_CHIPS_H5.availability: External input; supply it at the configured filesystem path and verify hashes against its protocol or manifest. Binary data is excluded from Git.

ELIGIBLE_CHIPS.description: 1198 eligible chips before the final central-quality exclusion; array hashes and indices are included. Depth estimates and source provenance are prepared evidence, not reconstructed by image downloading.
ELIGIBLE_CHIPS.availability: Included CSV; exact upstream depth preparation is not fully recoverable from this repository.

SPLIT_INITIALIZATION.description: Seeded ABSENT initialization assignments required by the partition search. Saved final partitions remain authoritative; solver reruns may produce equivalent different solutions.

configuration_notes: Paths resolve relative to the repository root and may use {KEY} references. Empty values require supplied input. KELP_CONFIG selects an alternate JSON file; missing keys inherit defaults. Use fresh runs/ destinations for training. configs/services.json supplies API endpoints; configs/references.json records citations.
